description:
Making an animated avatar is an excellent way to personalize faceless videos. You must have already watched videos of channels like 10x income with avatars talking, which get tons of views and engagement.

So today, I will show you step by step how to create a talking animated avatar for your faceless videos. And no, we are not talking about any paid tools:

00:00: Intro
00:37: Design Your Avatar
01:18: Remove Mouth
01:44: Edit and finalize your avatar
03:17: Bonus Tip

📝Tools Used:

1️⃣Character Ideas: https://chatgpt.com/

2️⃣Character Design: https://firefly.adobe.com/

3️⃣Remove Mouth: https://cleanup.pictures/

4️⃣Talking Mouth: https://www.adobe.com/express/feature/video/animation/audio (select category "mouth only") or search on YouTube as shown in the video

5️⃣Editing: Canva.com (or capcut)

👀Also Watch: https://youtu.be/jkUY_VYLHNM?si=ltb4M9rUXhjSsT-y (viral shorts niche)

💁🏻Join our exclusive discord server for AI tips and tricks: https://discord.gg/6h4KuMzQYE
